# docs-frontend-interface-inspirations

Curated visual/interaction inspirations for the frontend (Claude.ai design,
Notion, Obsidian, etc).

## Stack & contents

Mixed markdown + Next.js workspace artifacts. ~3,089 files including `agent-vm/ema-docs/` (ARCHITECTURE, EMA-FULL-CONTEXT, ROADMAP_SYNTHESIS, HERMES-EMA-AI-ENGINE-INTERFACE-PLAN) plus heavy `agent-vm/frontend-layer/.next/` and `node_modules/` residue.

## Why this is here

Despite the 'inspirations' framing, this branch carries a **second copy of EMA's architecture docs** in `agent-vm/ema-docs/` — useful as a cross-check against `codebase-ema/code/ema/docs/`. Note the build artifacts in `agent-vm/frontend-layer/`; ignore them.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/docs-frontend-interface-inspirations:agent-vm/ema-docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
git show origin/docs-frontend-interface-inspirations:agent-vm/ema-docs/EMA-FULL-CONTEXT.md
git show origin/docs-frontend-interface-inspirations:agent-vm/ema-docs/ROADMAP_SYNTHESIS.md
```
